intent_en: To demonstrate that the stock market is growing faster than wages, illustrating how capital returns outpace labor income and contribute to wealth concentration.
previous_intent: To illustrate the divergence between stock market growth and wage growth, demonstrating that capital returns are outpacing labor income.
narration_support: The rate of the return on capital or wealth is higher than the growth rate of the overall economy.
chart_support: Line chart comparing Indexed S&P 500 and Wage & Salary Accruals from 2007 to 2014, showing the S&P 500 rising much more steeply than wages.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly states that returns on capital exceed economic growth, and the chart visualizes this by showing the S&P 500 (capital) diverging significantly upward from wages (labor income) over the period 2007-2014.
